temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia is under financial stress and accepted the possibility of help, but Jose worries his offer may have felt intrusive or boundary-crossing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — his worry is resolved: Patricia does not think he overstepped and instead feels grateful for his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia welcomes his supportive concern and does not view his help as prying, so he can remain supportive while still respecting her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initially worried/anxious, then relieved and reassured.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Clarify boundaries, continue to support Patricia as a friend, and avoid being intrusive.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During a casual check-in, Patricia says everything is good and she plans a quiet weekend at home. She thanks Jose and says she will keep his offer in mind, but she does not share personal details. Jose senses she appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates his support and does not think he is prying, but Jose is still learning how much help or involvement she actually wants.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — he refines his belief: Patricia values his concern but likely prefers privacy and independence in handling her own issues.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her problems privately, so he should remain available without pushing.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Respectful concern, warmth, and mild uncertainty.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Give her space, keep interactions light and friendly, and remain available if she chooses to reach out.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose continues checking in supportively. Patricia says she is pretty busy but handling things, thanks him for checking in, and says it is great to have his support. Jose offers help with anything, even just grabbing coffee.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates his support but likely prefers to manage her issues privately; Jose believes the best approach is to stay available without pushing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change — the event confirms that Patricia is managing and values his supportive presence, but does not need immediate intervention.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is busy but handling things, and she appreciates his ongoing support; low-pressure availability is welcome.
